_approach: The rim takes over the kick's 2-step placements (1, a-of-2, and-of-3) at decoration velocity so the shuffle is implied rather than stated; one soft kick on the downbeat of bar 1 keeps the low end alive, a quiet shaker rolls 16ths, and the snare only speaks on beat 4 of bar 2 as the accent. Ref: dark-garage breakdowns (El-B, Horsepower Productions). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
